detail: While planning V0, nearly committed to building the automated retro loop (v1) before dogfooding it by hand on a real project — build ahead of validation. Corrected: Wizard-of-Oz the loop manually first, then automate only if it produces value.

On the Two Way Invoice Sync dogfood, init.md's emitter (phase 4) wrote CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md with byte-identical content (confirmed via diff -q). Duplication violates token-economy T1, and Claude Code reads ONLY CLAUDE.md while AGENTS.md is the cross-vendor standard. Fixed: AGENTS.md canonical + CLAUDE.md = one-line @AGENTS.md import.

Built the strict-path-guard hook using permissionDecision 'defer' from an unverified claude-code-guide answer. 'defer' is headless-only and wrong for an interactive passive warning (correct: exit 0 + additionalContext, no permissionDecision). Caught by the crossed adversarial review + a grounding pass. Lesson: ground every API claim against the docs before shipping code — even a claim from a sub-agent. voice V2 (verify before asserting) applies to sub-agent output too.
